product_overview: AI-Powered Smart Parking System is a mobile and management platform that helps drivers find, reserve, navigate to, and pay for parking while giving admins real-time control over occupancy, pricing, and reports. It combines license plate recognition, IoT-based slot monitoring, and booking/payment workflows to streamline parking operations and reduce congestion.
core_goals: Let drivers register, log in, and manage their vehicle details
Show real-time parking availability and help drivers search for suitable parking
Enable drivers to pre-book parking slots, pay for parking, and receive booking confirmation
Provide navigation guidance to the assigned parking slot
Support active parking session management, including extending time and ending a session
Allow users to view parking history and receipts
Give admins a dashboard to monitor occupancy, adjust rules and pricing, generate reports, and manually verify plates when needed

features.name: User Authentication and Account Creation
features.description: Drivers can create an account, sign in, and access the app securely before using parking services.
user_flows: Navigate to /create-account -> Enter name, phone number, and password -> Receive verification code -> Enter verification code -> Create account -> See authenticated home screen
Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter email or phone credentials and password -> Submit sign-in form -> See home screen
Navigate to /reset-password -> Start password recovery -> Follow the password reset flow -> Regain access to the account

features.name: Vehicle Profile Management
features.description: Logged-in drivers can add and maintain vehicle information so their cars can be recognized and linked to bookings.
user_flows: Navigate to /vehicles -> Add a vehicle -> Enter license plate number and vehicle model -> Optionally upload a plate photo -> Save vehicle details -> See vehicle linked to the account

features.name: Real-Time Parking Discovery
features.description: Drivers can browse nearby parking lots, check availability, and inspect lot details before booking.
user_flows: Navigate to /home -> View nearby parking options and current location -> Open search or map view -> Browse available lots and spot counts -> Select a parking lot -> See lot details and reviews
Navigate to /parking-search -> Search for parking nearby -> Apply filters for price and availability -> Review matching lots -> Open a lot detail view -> See the selected lot's information
Navigate to /map -> View the parking map -> Inspect markers and availability across the area -> Select a lot from the map -> See the chosen lot's details

features.name: Favorites and Parking Lot Details
features.description: Drivers can inspect a parking lot in detail and mark preferred locations for quicker access later.
user_flows: Navigate to /parking-lot-detail -> Review parking lot information -> Add the lot to favourites -> Return to the lot list with the selection saved
Navigate to /parking-lot-detail -> Review reviews and lot attributes -> Decide whether the lot fits the trip -> Proceed toward booking

features.name: Parking Reservation and Booking
features.description: Drivers can select a date, time, vehicle, and parking spot to reserve a place before arriving.
user_flows: Navigate to /booking-details -> Select date and time range -> Choose a vehicle -> Select a parking spot -> Confirm the booking details -> See booking confirmation
Navigate to /booking-details -> Select a booking time -> Review estimated fee -> Continue to payment step -> See reservation confirmation and booking ID
Navigate to /booking-details -> Choose a time range when no slots are available -> See that no reservation can be completed

features.name: Parking Payment and Wallet Top-Up
features.description: Drivers can pay for parking, review charges, and manage wallet funds for parking transactions.
user_flows: Navigate to /wallet -> View wallet balance -> Start a top-up -> Select an amount -> Complete top-up -> See updated balance and transaction record
From the booking or payment flow -> Review total parking cost -> Choose a payment method -> Submit payment -> See payment confirmed and booking finalized
Navigate to /wallet -> Open transaction history -> Review past top-ups and parking payments -> Return to the main app with transaction details visible

features.name: Navigation to Assigned Parking Spot
features.description: After a booking or allocation, drivers can receive directions to the assigned parking location and follow the route.
user_flows: From a confirmed booking -> Start navigation to the slot -> Receive route guidance -> Follow the path to the assigned parking spot -> Arrive at the destination
Navigate to /home or /map -> Open the booked lot or slot details -> Launch navigation guidance -> View the route to the parking area

features.name: Active Parking Session Management
features.description: Drivers can monitor their current parking session, extend duration, scan gate codes when needed, and end parking when leaving.
user_flows: Navigate to /active-session -> View session timer and spot details -> Extend the parking duration -> See the updated remaining time
Navigate to /active-session -> View current session status -> End the parking session -> See the final payment summary
Navigate to /active-session -> Review current parking session -> Complete the exit flow -> See the session marked as ended

features.name: Booking History and Receipts
features.description: Drivers can review past parking sessions, see parking details, and access digital receipts.
user_flows: Navigate to /bookings -> Open booking history -> Select a past reservation -> View the booking date, duration, and cost -> See the digital receipt
Navigate to /bookings -> Review active and completed reservations -> Open a specific entry -> Inspect transaction details

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Users can check in-app notifications related to bookings, payments, and parking activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /notifications -> Review recent alerts -> Open a booking or payment notification -> See the related parking update

features.name: Admin Dashboard and Parking Operations
features.description: Admins can monitor occupancy, review alerts, and manage parking operations from a centralized dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Open admin or management tools -> Review the dashboard summary -> See occupancy, revenue, and alerts
Open the web dashboard -> Inspect real-time parking metrics -> Filter the view by zone -> Review current operational status

features.name: Pricing, Rules, and Reports Management
features.description: Admins can adjust parking rules and pricing and generate operational reports.
user_flows: Open the settings area from /profile -> Update hourly rates or parking rules -> Save the configuration -> See the updated rules take effect
Open the reports section -> Choose a date range and report type -> Generate the report -> Download the file
Open the dashboard -> Review analytics and usage patterns -> Use the information to adjust operational settings

features.name: Manual Plate Verification and Gate Override
features.description: When a vehicle is not recognized or a booking needs confirmation, admins can verify details and authorize access manually.
user_flows: Receive an unidentified vehicle alert -> Open the live view or snapshot -> Review the vehicle details -> Correct the license plate information -> Confirm the match -> Allow the gate to open
Receive a booking dispute or recognition issue -> Inspect the record on the dashboard -> Validate the manual entry against reservations -> Issue a gate override -> See the manual action logged

known_limitations.issue: Google Maps and geolocation require browser permissions and may behave differently on Flutter web vs mobile
known_limitations.impact: Map tab and outdoor navigation may show limited functionality in web test environment

known_limitations.issue: QR gate scan screens depend on device camera APIs not fully available in all browsers
known_limitations.impact: Gate entry/exit scan flows may not be testable in headless web automation

known_limitations.issue: Firebase Auth Google sign-in popup flow may be blocked or differ on localhost web builds
known_limitations.impact: Google OAuth tests may fail without proper authorized domains configured
